title: DashboardSummary
description: Response of `GET /api/v1/dashboard`: the user's dashboard without its items.

mentions.description: Unanswered, unhidden mentions, oldest first; independent of the ranking.

mention_coverage.description: Mention reads omitted in this snapshot, independent of item filters and pagination.

revision.description: Opaque; changes whenever the stored snapshot or its ranking changes (poll this, then fetch the items).

latest_refresh.description: The newest refresh of the user, live or ended; null before the first.

snapshot.description: The snapshot the items come from; null before the first successful scan.

older_prompt_judgements.description: Items of the snapshot whose judgement came from an older ranking prompt (re-judged within the caps).

plugins.description:
Configured dashboard plug-ins (ADR-022); absent when none is configured. While one is listed, the browser
reads the summary again every minute.

Mention.description: A request addressed to a scanned login, outside the ranked list.

partly_read.description: Only a bounded part of this conversation was read.

id.description: Stable opaque identity of this post on this item (used by Hide).

author.description: Mentioning author; a deleted account is shown as `ghost`.

is_bot.description: GitHub Bot type, [bot] suffix or the user's known bots.

created_at.description: When the mentioning post was created.

text.description: One line of the mentioning text, plain text only.

url.description: Server-built GitHub link to the mentioning post.

GithubKind.description: GitHub item kinds of the list filter `kind`.

oneOf.description: Pull requests.
Issues.

MentionCoverage.description: Missing mention reads; zero items does not imply that every login was searched.

unchecked_items.description: Real candidates not checked because of the read budget, deadline or read failure.

unchecked_logins.description: Logins whose mention search was unavailable; fallback covers only mention-only issues.

timed_out_logins.description: Logins whose PR mention search exceeded its request budget.

RefreshStatus.description: One refresh: scan progress, ranking and outcome (`GET /api/v1/dashboard/refreshes/{id}`, SSE `refresh`).

judged.description: Items the LLM judged in this refresh.

reused.description: Items whose stored judgement was reused at no cost (judged inputs unchanged).

left_provisional.description: Items left provisional by the per-refresh or daily ranking limit.

scanned_at.description: When the scan finished and the snapshot was stored; null while scanning or when it failed.

ranking.description: The LLM ranking of the snapshot; null before the scan finished.

failure.description: Why the scan failed; null unless `failed`.

log.description: Plain log lines of the scan (at most 200, oldest first); no tokens, no query strings.

RefreshId.description: Identifier of a dashboard refresh (one scan and its ranking).

oneOf.description: The user's Refresh action.
The daily schedule.
My work was open and the newest refresh was old (plan §M).

RefreshState.description:
State of a refresh; transitions in `docs/contracts/http-api.md` "Refresh states". At most one refresh per user
is `scanning` or `ranking`; only `ranking` and `finished` refreshes hold a snapshot.

oneOf.description: Reading GitHub and MemCan; no snapshot yet.
The snapshot is stored and current; the LLM judges new and changed items.
The snapshot is current; the ranking ended with the outcome in `ranking.state`.
The scan failed before its snapshot was complete; the previous snapshot stays.
The scan was cancelled before its snapshot was complete; the previous snapshot stays.

ScanStep.description: A step of the scan, shown as a list with progress.

done.description: Units done (e.g. PR details read); null when the step has no count.

total.description: Units in total; null when not known yet or not counted.

detail.description: Plain detail, e.g. the item being read or why the step failed.

oneOf.description: Pull request searches (authored, assigned, review requested).
Issue searches (watched repositories, assigned, mentions).
Pull request details (CI, reviews, threads, timeline).
Ownership policies, releases, milestones, reach.
Pull request and review history for the charts.
MemCan TODOs.
LLM ranking of new and changed items.
Not started.
In progress.
Done.
Failed; `detail` says why.
Not run (e.g. TODOs switched off).

RankingStatus.description: The LLM ranking of a stored snapshot.

total.description: Items queued for judgement in this refresh.

resumes_at.description: When a usage-limit pause ends; null unless `paused`.

message.description: Plain text of a failure; null unless `failed` or `interrupted`.

RankingState.description: State of the LLM ranking (plan §B.3); the last four end it and leave the refresh `finished`.

oneOf.description: Queued behind a review analysis that holds the LLM credential.
Judging.
Paused by the provider's usage limit; continues by itself at `resumes_at`.
Failed; provisional scores stay approximate (Retry ranking).
Stopped by a server restart (Retry ranking).
Cancelled by the user (Retry ranking).
Done, or nothing needed judging.

retry_at.description: Earliest time a new refresh can succeed (GitHub rate-limit reset); null when not limited.

oneOf.description: GitHub's rate limit; `retry_at` is its reset.
GitHub failed or answered unexpectedly.
The user's GitHub sign-in is no longer usable; sign in again.
The refresh took longer than its limit (5 minutes).
A server restart interrupted the scan.
Anything else.

SnapshotMeta.description: Facts of the stored snapshot besides its items.

ranked_at.description: When its ranking finished; null while ranking or when it did not finish.

item_counts.description: Ranked items by kind and tier.

excluded.description: Items left out of the ranking (`exclusions.total`).

awaiting.description: The user's pull requests waiting on other people.

ready_to_merge.description:
The user's pull requests ready to merge at the scan (plan K17), by display id; also ranked. A pull request a
current plug-in statement holds back (ADR-022) is left out and stays ranked with its note.

merge_state_pending.description:
The user's pull requests Ready to merge could list (into the default branch or a release branch) whose merge
state GitHub had not computed by the scan (read again by the next refresh); null when the snapshot did not
record merge states (stored before they were).

history.description: Dated pull request and review events of the chart window (12 weeks), across the scanned logins.

notes.description: What the scan missed or approximated.

unreachable.description: Configured repositories and owners the user's GitHub token cannot see (`owner/name` or `owner`).

checked.description: What the scan read before exclusion.

exclusions.description:
Why the rules left items out, computed with the ranking; absent only from a response without it (a server
older than this field), which the web shows as not recorded.

facts_checked_at.description:
When the listed pull requests' facts (CI, reviews, merge state) were last checked against GitHub after the scan,
while My work was open (plan §M); absent when none was since the scan or the server restarted since.

ItemCounts.description: Ranked items by kind and tier.

not_judged.description: Items in the group "Not judged yet" (score state `unjudged`; also counted in their tier).

AwaitingItem.description: A pull request of the user that waits on other people.

url.description: GitHub link, built by the server.

waiting_on.description:
Whom to ping: logins and teams (`team:<slug>`) whose review is requested, or those a plug-in says owe a
review; empty when nobody is named.

waiting_since.description: Since when it waits (the oldest open request; else when the pull request was opened).

tags.description: Deterministic tags from scan facts (e.g. CI passing).

change_size.description: Size mark of its full diff (display only); absent when the totals are unknown.

total_tenths.description: Always null: a pull request waiting only on others is not ranked (kept for compatibility).

AwaitingReason.description: Why a pull request of the user waits on other people (plan K15 W3), the first that applies.

oneOf.description: It carries the "Ready for a human" label (Settings): it needs a human, even if GitHub lets the user merge it.
A current plug-in statement says the move is the reviewers' or maintainers' (ADR-022).

source.description: Name of the plug-in, shown before the reason.

url.description: Evidence: the source's record of the pull request.

oneOf.description: A review is requested from others, it is not approved and GitHub does not let the user merge it.

FactTag.description: A deterministic tag from scan facts.

ChangeSizeMark.description: A pull request's size mark with its evidence (a scan fact, not a score input).

additions.description: Added lines of the full diff.

deletions.description: Removed lines of the full diff.

SizeMark.description: Size mark of a pull request: a fixed table of changed lines (additions + deletions), plan §C.2 K16.

oneOf.description: Fewer than 150 changed lines.
150 to 499 changed lines.
500 to 2999 changed lines.
3000 to 9999 changed lines.
10 000 changed lines or more.

ReadyToMergeItem.description:
A pull request of the user ready to merge: into the default branch or a release branch, not a draft, write
access, every check passed except ignored ones, nothing left to answer and no ready label (plan K17).

url.description: GitHub link, built by the server.

tags.description: Deterministic tags from scan facts (CI state; checks not passing that are not required).

change_size.description: Size mark of its full diff (display only); absent when the totals are unknown.

HistoryEvent.description: A dated event for the charts.

item_id.description: The pull request, `owner/name#number`; one event per pull request and kind.

HistoryKind.description: Kind of a history event; pull requests and reviews only (OD16).

oneOf.description: A pull request authored by a scanned login was opened.
It was merged.
It was closed without merging.
A scanned login submitted a review on a pull request.

TodosState.description: State of the MemCan TODOs in the snapshot.

read_at.description: When the TODO rows shown were read; null when none were read.

failed_at.description: When MemCan could not be reached; null unless `not_refreshed`.

TodosStatus.description: Whether the TODO rows are current.

oneOf.description: Read in this refresh.
MemCan was unreachable; the rows come from an earlier snapshot.
The user switched TODOs off.
MemCan is not configured on this server.

ScanNote.description: Something the scan missed or approximated (plain text).

item.description: The item it concerns, if one.

Exclusions.description:
The items left out of the ranking, counted per reason. No LLM text; `judged_not_eligible` and
`merged_into_another` are LLM decisions, the other reasons deterministic rules.

counts.description: Non-zero counts, in the order of [`ExclusionReason`].

items.description: With `?excluded=true` only: the items by reason, then display id, at most [`EXCLUDED_ITEMS_LIMIT`].

ExclusionCount.description: How many items one rule left out.

ExclusionReason.description: The rule that left an item out of the ranking. Clients show an unknown value as a plain "other rule".

oneOf.description: Written by an excluded author (Settings → Excluded authors).

A pull request of someone else not directed at the user, with no or only a minor change in the user's
owned paths (Settings → Ownership policy).
A draft pull request of someone else (only the user's own drafts count).
The LLM, asked because the ownership policy could not be read, judged it outside the user's areas.
The LLM merged it into another item covering the same work.

The user snoozed it (`ExcludedItem.snoozed_until`); it wakes then, or earlier on a new review request to the
user or a new mention of the user.

ExcludedItem.description: One item the rules left out.

url.description: Link: GitHub, or the MemCan UI for a TODO when configured.

merged_into.description: Display id of the item it was merged into (`merged_into_another` only).

oneOf.description: A GitHub pull request.
A GitHub issue.
A MemCan TODO.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone; null until known (the schedule does not run without it).

next_run_at.description: Next scheduled instant; null when off or without a time zone.

last_run.description: The most recent scheduled run; null before the first.

at.description: Its scheduled instant (the configured local time on that local date).

oneOf.description: A scheduled refresh was started (its result is that refresh's).
Not needed: a refresh succeeded after the scheduled time, or one was scanning (a ranking is superseded).
No usable GitHub sign-in; shown until a later refresh succeeds.
The scheduled refresh failed; shown until a later refresh succeeds.

PluginStatus.description: A configured dashboard plug-in: an external source of statements about pull requests (ADR-022).

source.description: Name shown before its statements, e.g. `PR Hygiene`.

state.description: Whether its statements are shown now.

as_of.description: When the source produced the data last read; null before the first successful read.

holds_ready_to_merge.description: The plug-in can hold a pull request back from Ready to merge (PR Hygiene); absent when it never does.

PluginState.description: Whether a plug-in's statements are shown.

oneOf.description: Not read yet, or not read recently because nobody used the dashboard (it is read only then); being read.
Read recently; its statements are shown.

The source failed since its last good read, or its data is older than the freshness bound; nothing of it is
shown.
